@copilot 仔细评估当前改动的必要性是否与现有的协议重复或冲突

> @copilot 仔细评估当前改动的必要性是否与现有的协议重复或冲突

Evaluated all three proposed fields — all are redundant with existing protocol:

- **`source`** duplicates `data: { provider: 'object', object: '...' }` (ViewDataSchema line 31-34)
- **`groupBy`** duplicates `grouping: { fields: [{ field: '...' }] }` (GroupingConfigSchema line 132-134)
- **`typeOptions`** (`Record<string, unknown>`) undermines the Zod-first typed configs (`kanban`, `calendar`, `gantt`, `gallery`, `timeline`)
- **`description`** already exists on ListViewSchema (line 406)

Reverted all additions in `b453f26`. The objectui console should align to the existing protocol fields rather than adding shorthand aliases that create ambiguity about source-of-truth.
